client.description: Who asks for the review (package 0.1.48) and how that person has the client set up (package 0.1.49), as the client declares it. Display data the sidecar does not check: the review window names the client and follows its language, colour mode and text size. A value the sidecar cannot use is dropped, not refused.

platform.description: The client's surface, its X-Erato-Platform value such as web or outlook.

locale.description: The client's active language as a BCP-47 tag.

theme_mode.description: The person's colour mode: light, dark or system.

text_size.description: The person's text size: small, default, large or x-large.
